type { Express, Request, Response } from \"express\";\nimport type Database from \"better-sqlite3\";\nimport { getUser, getVisitorId, appNow } from \"../db/initialize.js\";\n\ntype CommentRow = {\n  id: number; post_type: string; post_id: number; parent_comment_id: number | null;\n  author_id: number; body: string; upvotes: number; is_deleted: number;\n  created_at: string; updated_at: string | null;\n  display_name: string | null; email: string; my_vote: number | null;\n};\ntype CountRow = { c: number };\ntype PostRow = { id: number };\n\nconst EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;\n\nfunction authorName(display_name: string | null, email: string): string {\n  return display_name && display_name.trim() ? display_name : email;\n}\n\nexport function registerDomain5Part0(app: Express, connection: Database.Database): void {\n  app.get(\"/api/comments\", (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    const postType = String(req.query.post_type ?? \"\");\n    const postId = Number(req.query.post_id);\n    if (postType !== \"question\" && postType !== \"answer\") {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"invalid_post_type\" });\n    }\n    if (!Number.isInteger(postId) || postId <= 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"invalid_post_id\" });\n    }\n    const user = getUser(connection, req);\n    const me = user ? Number(user.id) : null;\n    const rows = connection\n      .prepare(\n        `SELECT c.id,c.post_type,c.post_id,c.parent_comment_id,c.author_id,c.body,c.upvotes,\n                c.is_deleted,c.created_at,c.updated_at,u.display_name,u.email,\n                (SELECT 1 FROM comment_votes cv WHERE cv.comment_id=c.id AND cv.user_id=?) AS my_vote\n         FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.author_id\n         WHERE c.post_type=? AND c.post_id=? AND c.is_deleted=0\n         ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC`\n      )\n      .all(me, postType, postId) as CommentRow[];\n    const now = appNow();\n    const comments = rows.map((r) => {\n      const created = Date.parse(r.created_at);\n      const within = Number.isFinite(created) && now - created <= EDIT_WINDOW_MS;\n      const isOwner = me !== null && me === r.author_id;\n      return {\n        id: r.id,\n        post_type: r.post_type,\n        post_id: r.post_id,\n        parent_comment_id: r.parent_comment_id,\n        body: r.body,\n        upvotes: r.upvotes,\n        my_vote: r.my_vote === 1,\n        can_edit: isOwner && within,\n        can_delete: isOwner,\n        is_owner: isOwner,\n        created_at: r.created_at,\n        updated_at: r.updated_at,\n        edited: !!r.updated_at,\n        author: { id: r.author_id, display_name: authorName(r.display_name, r.email) },\n      };\n    });\n    const shown = comments.length;\n    const totalAll = connection\n      .prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM comments WHERE post_type=? AND post_id=?`)\n      .get(postType, postId) as CountRow;\n    const hidden = Math.max(0, shown - 5);\n    return res.json({ comments, total: shown, hidden_count: hidden });\n  });\n\n  app.post(\"/api/comments\", (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    const user = getUser(connection, req);\n    if (!user) return res.status(401).json({ error: \"auth_required\" });\n    const uid = Number(user.id);\n    const body = req.body ?? {};\n    const postType = String(body.post_type ?? \"\");\n    const postId = Number(body.post_id);\n    const text = String(body.body ?? \"\").trim();\n    const parentRaw = body.parent_comment_id;\n    if (postType !== \"question\" && postType !== \"answer\") {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"invalid_post_type\" });\n    }\n    if (!Number.isInteger(postId) || postId <= 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"invalid_post_id\" });\n    }\n    if (!text) return res.status(400).json({ error: \"body_empty\" });\n\n    const table = postType === \"question\" ? \"questions\" : \"answers\";\n    const post = connection\n      .prepare(`SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE id=? AND is_deleted=0`)\n      .get(postId) as PostRow | undefined;\n    if (!post) return res.status(404).json({ error: \"post_not_found\" });\n\n    let parentId: number | null = null;\n    if (parentRaw !== undefined && parentRaw !== null && parentRaw !== \"\") {\n      const p = Number(parentRaw);\n      if (!Number.isInteger(p) || p <= 0) {\n        return res.status(400).json({ error: \"parent_not_found\" });\n      }\n      const parent = connection\n        .prepare(\n          `SELECT id FROM comments WHERE id=? AND post_type=? AND post_id=? AND is_deleted=0`\n        )\n        .get(p, postType, postId) as PostRow | undefined;\n      if (!parent) return res.status(404).json({ error: \"parent_not_found\" });\n      parentId = p;\n    }\n\n    const nowIso = new Date(appNow()).toISOString();\n    const info = connection\n      .prepare(\n        `INSERT INTO comments (post_type,post_id,parent_comment_id,author_id,body,upvotes,is_deleted,created_at,updated_at)\n         VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,0,0,?,NULL)`\n      )\n      .run(postType, postId, parentId, uid, text, nowIso);\n    const newId = Number(info.lastInsertRowid);\n    getVisitorId(req, res);\n    return res.status(201).json({\n      comment: {\n        id: newId,\n        post_type: postType,\n        post_id: postId,\n        parent_comment_id: parentId,\n        body: text,\n        upvotes: 0,\n        created_at: nowIso,\n        author: { id: uid, display_name: authorName(user.display_name, user.email) },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  app.put(\"/api/comments/:id\", (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    const user = getUser(connection, req);\n    if (!user) return res.status(401).json({ error: \"auth_required\" });\n    const uid = Number(user.id);\n    const id = Number(req.params.id);\n    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    const text = String((req.body ?? {}).body ?? \"\").trim();\n    if (!text) return res.status(400).json({ error: \"body_empty\" });\n\n    const row = connection\n      .prepare(`SELECT id,author_id,created_at,is_deleted FROM comments WHERE id=?`)\n      .get(id) as { id: number; author_id: number; created_at: string; is_deleted: number } | undefined;\n    if (!row || row.is_deleted === 1) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    if (row.author_id !== uid) {\n      return res.status(403).json({ error: \"not_owner\" });\n    }\n    const created = Date.parse(row.created_at);\n    const now = appNow();\n    if (!Number.isFinite(created) || now - created > EDIT_WINDOW_MS) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"edit_window_expired\" });\n    }\n    const nowIso = new Date(now).toISOString();\n    connection\n      .prepare(`UPDATE comments SET body=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?`)\n      .run(text, nowIso, id);\n    return res.json({\n      comment: { id, body: text, updated_at: nowIso, edited: true },\n    });\n  });\n}","sha256":"0732eb18d2144ca5f31a979f2cceb77b85363519658f2e901aa03dc53b6f70f9"},"backend/src/api/domain5-part1.ts":{"content":"import type { Express, Request, Response } from \"express\";\nimport type Database from \"better-sqlite3\";\nimport { getUser } from \"../db/initialize.js\";\n\ntype CommentRow = {\n  id: number;\n  author_id: number;\n  upvotes: number;\n  is_deleted: number;\n};\n\ntype VoteRow = { id: number; vote_type: number };\n\nexport function registerDomain5Part1(app: Express, connection: Database.Database): void {\n  app.delete(\"/api/comments/:id\", (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    const user = getUser(connection, req);\n    if (!user) return res.status(401).json({ error: \"auth_required\" });\n    const uid = Number(user.id);\n    const id = Number(req.params.id);\n    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    const row = connection\n      .prepare(`SELECT id,author_id,upvotes,is_deleted FROM comments WHERE id=?`)\n      .get(id) as CommentRow | undefined;\n    if (!row || row.is_deleted === 1) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    if (row.author_id !== uid) {\n      return res.status(403).json({ error: \"not_owner\" });\n    }\n    connection.transaction(() => {\n      connection\n        .prepare(`UPDATE comments SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=? OR parent_comment_id=?`)\n        .run(id, id);\n    })();\n    return res.json({ ok: true, deleted_id: id });\n  });\n\n  app.post(\"/api/comments/:id/vote\", (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    const user = getUser(connection, req);\n    if (!user) return res.status(401).json({ error: \"auth_required\" });\n    const uid = Number(user.id);\n    const id = Number(req.params.id);\n    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    const row = connection\n      .prepare(`SELECT id,author_id,upvotes,is_deleted FROM comments WHERE id=?`)\n      .get(id) as CommentRow | undefined;\n    if (!row || row.is_deleted === 1) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"not_found\" });\n    }\n    if (row.author_id === uid) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: \"cannot_vote_own\" });\n    }\n    const result = connection.transaction((): { upvotes: number; my_vote: boolean } => {\n      const existing = connection\n        .prepare(`SELECT id,vote_type FROM comment_votes WHERE comment_id=? AND user_id=?`)\n        .get(id, uid) as VoteRow | undefined;\n      let upvotes: number;\n      let myVote: boolean;\n      if (existing) {\n        connection.prepare(`DELETE FROM comment_votes WHERE id=?`).run(existing.id);\n        connection.prepare(`UPDATE comments SET upvotes=upvotes-1 WHERE id=?`).run(id);\n        const cur = connection\n          .prepare(`SELECT upvotes FROM comments WHERE id=?`)\n          .get(id) as { upvotes: number };\n        upvotes = cur.upvotes;\n        myVote = false;\n      } else {\n        connection\n          .prepare(\n            `INSERT INTO comment_votes (comment_id,user_id,vote_type,created_at) VALUES (?,?,1,?)`\n          )\n          .run(id, uid, new Date().toISOString());\n        connection.prepare(`UPDATE comments SET upvotes=upvotes+1 WHERE id=?`).run(id);\n        const cur = connection\n          .prepare(`SELECT upvotes FROM comments WHERE id=?`)\n          .get(id) as { upvotes: number };\n        upvotes = });\n}","sha256":"88102f03b31553ab3a33bc7265596cea4b9a7455bec255b3642371dd4d0ef6f3"},"backend/src/api/domain5.ts":{"content":"import type {Express} from \"express\";\nimport type Database from type {Express,Request,Response} from \"express\";\nimport type Database from \"better-sqlite3\";\nimport {getUser} from \"../db/initialize.js\";\n\ninterface TagRow{id:number;name:string;description:string|null;question_count:number;}\ninterface QuestionRow{id:number;title:string;score:number;answer_count:number;view_count:number;asked_at:string|null;modified_at:string|null;author_id:number;display_name:string|null;}\ninterface NameRow{name:string;}\ninterface WatchedRow{id:number;name:string;question_count:number;created_at:string;}\ninterface RelatedRow{id:number;name:string;question_count:number;}\n\nfunction normTags(value:unknown):string[]{\n if(!Array.isArray(value))return [];\n const out:string[]=[];\n for(const item of value){\n  if(typeof item===\"string\"&&item.trim()){out.push(item.trim().toLowerCase());}\n }\n return Array.from(new Set(out));\n}\n\nfunction decorate(connection:Database.Database,rows:QuestionRow[]):Array<Record<string,unknown>>{\n const tagStmt=connection.prepare(\"SELECT t.name FROM question_tags qt JOIN tags t ON t.id=qt.tag_id WHERE qt.question_id=? ORDER BY t.name\");\n return rows.map((r)=>{\n  const tags=(tagStmt.all(r.id) as NameRow[]).map((x)=>x.name);\n  return {id:r.id,title:r.title,score:r.score,answer_count:r.answer_count,view_count:r.view_count,asked_at:r.asked_at,modified_at:r.modified_at,tags,author:{id:r.author_id,display_name:r.display_name}};\n });\n}\n\nexport function registerDomain6Part0(app:Express,connection:Database.Database):void{\n const qBase=\"FROM questions q JOIN users u ON u.id=q.author_id WHERE q.is_deleted=0\";\n\n app.get(\"/api/tags\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const page=Math.max(1,parseInt(String(req.query.page||\"1\"),10)||1);\n  const limit=20,offset=(page-1)*limit;\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  const total=(connection.prepare(\"SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM tags\").get() as {c:number}).c;\n  const rows=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id,name,description,question_count FROM tags ORDER BY question_count DESC, name ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\").all(limit,offset) as TagRow[];\n  const watchStmt=connection.prepare(\"SELECT 1 FROM tag_watches WHERE user_id=? AND tag_id=?\");\n  const tags=rows.map((r)=>{\n   const watched=me?!!watchStmt.get(me.id,r.id):false;\n   return {id:r.id,name:r.name,description:r.description,question_count:r.question_count,watched};\n  });\n  res.json({tags,page,has_next:offset+rows.length<total,total});\n });\n\n app.get(\"/api/tags/watched\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  if(!me){res.json({watched_tags:[]});return;}\n  const rows=connection.prepare(\"SELECT t.id,t.name,t.question_count,tw.created_at FROM tag_watches tw JOIN tags t ON t.id=tw.tag_id WHERE tw.user_id=? ORDER BY tw.created_at DESC, tw.id DESC\").all(me.id) as WatchedRow[];\n  res.json({watched_tags:rows.map((r)=>({id:r.id,name:r.name,question_count:r.question_count,created_at:r.created_at}))});\n });\n\n app.get(\"/api/tags/:name\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const name=String(req.params.name||\"\").toLowerCase();\n  const tag=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id,name,description,question_count FROM tags WHERE name=?\").get(name) as TagRow|undefined;\n  if(!tag){res.status(404).json({error:\"not_found\"});return;}\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  const watched=me?!!connection.prepare(\"SELECT 1 FROM tag_watches WHERE user_id=? AND tag_id=?\").get(me.id,tag.id):false;\n  const related=connection.prepare(\"SELECT t.id,t.name,t.question_count,COUNT(*) c FROM question_tags a JOIN question_tags b ON a.question_id=b.question_id AND a.tag_id<>b.tag_id JOIN tags t ON t.id=b.tag_id WHERE a.tag_id=? GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY c DESC, t.question_count DESC, t.name ASC LIMIT 10\").all(tag.id) as RelatedRow[];\n  const page=Math.max(1,parseInt(String(req.query.page||\"1\"),10)||1);\n  const limit=20,offset=(page-1)*limit;\n  const unanswered=String(req.query.unanswered||\"\")===\"true\";\n  const sortRaw=String(req.query.sort||\"Newest\");\n  const sort=sortRaw===\"Active\"?\"Active\":\"Newest\";\n  const orderCol=sort===\"Active\"?\"q.modified_at\":\"q.asked_at\";\n  let where=`${qBase} AND q.id IN (SELECT question_id FROM question_tags WHERE tag_id=?)`;\n  if(unanswered)where+=\" AND q.answer_count=0\";\n  const total=(connection.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) c ${where}`).get(tag.id) as {c:number}).c;\n  const rows=connection.prepare(`SELECT q.id,q.title,q.score,q.answer_count,q.view_count,q.asked_at,q.modified_at,q.author_id,u.display_name ${where} ORDER BY ${orderCol} DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`).all(tag.id,limit,offset) as QuestionRow[];\n  res.json({\n   tag:{id:tag.id,name:tag.name,description:tag.description,question_count:tag.question_count},\n   watched,related_tags:related.map((r)=>({id:r.id,name:r.name,question_count:r.question_count})),\n   questions:decorate(connection,rows),page,has_next:offset+rows.length<total,unanswered,sort\n  });\n });\n}","sha256":"b16a762d3adff354118763ca4b872dd8263e96b5c0e7aaa661b70af17ab3b90f"},"backend/src/api/domain6-part1.ts":{"content":"import type {Express,Request,Response} from \"express\";\nimport type Database from \"better-sqlite3\";\nimport {getUser,appNow} from \"../db/initialize.js\";\n\ninterface TagRow{id:number;name:string;description:string|null;question_count:number;}\ninterface QuestionRow{id:number;title:string;score:number;answer_count:number;view_count:number;asked_at:string|null;modified_at:string|null;author_id:number;display_name:string|null;}\ninterface NameRow{name:string;}\ninterface FilterRow{id:number;title:string;unanswered:number;sort:string|null;tags:string|null;created_at:string|null;}\n\nfunction normTags(value:unknown):string[]{\n if(!Array.isArray(value))return [];\n const out:string[]=[];\n for(const item of value){\n  if(typeof item===\"string\"&&item.trim()){out.push(item.trim().toLowerCase());}\n }\n return Array.from(new Set(out));\n}\n\nfunction parseTags(raw:string|null):string[]{\n if(!raw)return [];\n try{\n  const v=JSON.parse(raw);\n  if(Array.isArray(v))return v.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x===\"string\");\n }catch{}\n return [];\n}\n\nfunction decorate(connection:Database.Database,rows:QuestionRow[]):Array<Record<string,unknown>>{\n const tagStmt=connection.prepare(\"SELECT t.name FROM question_tags qt JOIN tags t ON t.id=qt.tag_id WHERE qt.question_id=? ORDER BY t.name\");\n return rows.map((r)=>{\n  const tags=(tagStmt.all(r.id) as NameRow[]).map((x)=>x.name);\n  return {id:r.id,title:r.title,score:r.score,answer_count:r.answer_count,view_count:r.view_count,asked_at:r.asked_at,modified_at:r.modified_at,tags,author:{id:r.author_id,display_name:r.display_name}};\n });\n}\n\nexport function registerDomain6Part1(app:Express,connection:Database.Database):void{\n const qBase=\"FROM questions q JOIN users u ON u.id=q.author_id WHERE q.is_deleted=0\";\n\n app.post(\"/api/tags/:name/watch\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  if(!me){res.status(401).json({error:\"auth_required\"});return;}\n  const name=String(req.params.name||\"\").toLowerCase();\n  const tag=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id,name FROM tags WHERE name=?\").get(name) as {id:number;name:string}|undefined;\n  if(!tag){res.status(404).json({error:\"not_found\"});return;}\n  const now=new Date(appNow()).toISOString();\n  const watched=connection.transaction(():boolean=>{\n   const existing=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id FROM tag_watches WHERE user_id=? AND tag_id=?\").get(me.id,tag.id) as {id:number}|undefined;\n   if(existing){\n    connection.prepare(\"DELETE FROM tag_watches WHERE id=?\").run(existing.id);\n    return false;\n   }\n   connection.prepare(\"INSERT INTO tag_watches (user_id,tag_id,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?)\").run(me.id,tag.id,now);\n   return true;\n  })();\n  const watchedRows=connection.prepare(\"SELECT t.name FROM tag_watches tw JOIN tags t ON t.id=tw.tag_id WHERE tw.user_id=? ORDER BY tw.created_at DESC, tw.id DESC\").all(me.id) as NameRow[];\n  res.json({tag:{name:tag.name},watched,watched_tags:watchedRows.map((r)=>r.name)});\n });\n\n app.get(\"/api/search\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const q=String(req.query.q||\"\").trim();\n  const page=Math.max(1,parseInt(String(req.query.page||\"1\"),10)||1);\n  const limit=20,offset=(page-1)*limit;\n  if(!q){res.json({query:q,results:[],suggestions:[],page,has_next:false,total:0});return;}\n  const like=`%${q.toLowerCase()}%`;\n  const where=`${qBase} AND (LOWER(q.title) LIKE ? OR LOWER(q.body) LIKE ? OR q.id IN (SELECT qt.question_id FROM question_tags qt JOIN tags t ON t.id=qt.tag_id WHERE LOWER(t.name) LIKE ?))`;\n  const relevance=\"CASE WHEN LOWER(q.title)=? THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(q.title) LIKE ? THEN 1 ELSE 2 END\";\n  const params:[string,string,string,string,string]=[like,like,like,q.toLowerCase(),like];\n  const total=(connection.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) c ${where}`).get(like,like,like) as {c:number}).c;\n  const rows=connection.prepare(`SELECT q.id,q.title,q.score,q.answer_count,q.view_count,q.asked_at,q.modified_at,q.author_id,u.display_name ${where} ORDER BY ${relevance} ASC, q.score DESC, q.asked_at DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`).all(...params,limit,offset) as QuestionRow[];\n  const suggestions=connection.prepare(`SELECT q.id,q.title ${where} ORDER BY ${relevance} ASC, q.score DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT 5`).all(like,like,like,q.toLowerCase(),like) as Array<{id:number;title:string}>;\n  res.json({\n   query:q,results:decorate(connection,rows),\n   suggestions:suggestions.map((r)=>({id:r.id,title:r.title})),\n   page,has_next:offset+rows.length<total,total\n  });\n });\n\n app.post(\"/api/filters\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  if(!me){res.status(401).json({error:\"auth_required\"});return;}\n  const title=typeof req.body?.title===\"string\"?req.body.title.trim():\"\";\n  if(!title){res.status(400).json({error:\"title_required\"});return;}\n  const unanswered=req.body?.unanswered===true?1:0;\n  const sortRaw=String(req.body?.sort||\"Newest\");\n  const sort=sortRaw===\"Active\"?\"Active\":\"Newest\";\n  const tags=normTags(req.body?.tags);\n  const now=new Date(appNow()).toISOString();\n  const info=connection.prepare(\"INSERT INTO saved_filters (user_id,title,unanswered,sort,tags,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)\").run(me.id,title,unanswered,sort,JSON.stringify(tags),now);\n  const id=Number(info.lastInsertRowid);\n  res.status(201).json({filter:{id,title,unanswered:unanswered===1,sort,tags,created_at:now}});\n });\n\n app.get(\"/api/filters\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  if(!me){res.json({filters:[]});return;}\n  const rows=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id,title,unanswered,sort,tags,created_at FROM saved_filters WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC\").all(me.id) as FilterRow[];\n  res.json({filters:rows.map((r)=>({id:r.id,title:r.title,unanswered:r.unanswered===1,sort:r.sort===\"Active\"?\"Active\":\"Newest\",tags:parseTags(r.tags),created_at:r.created_at}))});\n });\n}","sha256":"29e597d0e6a75a6a4a912d0f72355d0bb3d7f36d7ca2e74967f156c6980c0362"},"backend/src/api/domain6-part2.ts":{"content":"import type {Express,Request,Response} from \"express\";\nimport type Database from \"better-sqlite3\";\nimport {getUser} from \"../db/initialize.js\";\n\ninterface FilterRow{id:number;title:string;unanswered:number;sort:string|null;tags:string|null;created_at:string|null;}\n\nfunction parseTags(raw:string|null):string[]{\n if(!raw)return [];\n try{\n  const v=JSON.parse(raw);\n  if(Array.isArray(v))return v.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x===\"string\");\n }catch{}\n return [];\n}\n\nexport function registerDomain6Part2(app:Express,connection:Database.Database):void{\n app.get(\"/api/filters\",(req:Request,res:Response)=>{\n  const me=getUser(connection,req) as {id:number}|null;\n  if(!me){res.json({filters:[]});return;}\n  const rows=connection.prepare(\"SELECT id,title,unanswered,sort,tags,created_at FROM saved_filters WHERE user_id=? res.json({filters:rows.map((r)=>({id:r.id,title:r.title,unanswered:r.unanswered===1,sort:r.sort===\"Active\"?\"Active\":\"Newest\",tags:parseTags(r.tags),created_at:r.created_at}))});\n '+path.replace(/\\/$/,'').replace(/:[^/]+/g,':param').toLowerCase();\ntype Candidate={method:string;path:string;handlers:any[]};\nconst roots=new WeakMap<object,Express>();\nconst states=new
